amends: PREREGISTRATION.json (round 1). Benchmark, runtime, server arguments, sampling and max_tokens are unchanged; round 1's condition block applies verbatim.
question: Does a RAM-resident mid-size MoE (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, experts in system RAM) or a larger dense member of the deployed family (Qwen3.5-9B) beat the deployed Qwen3.5-4B on owner hardware, and do round-1 rankings hold on the independent adjudicated suite?

benchmarks.independent: labs/intelligence-bakeoff/adjudicated frozen 180 episodes, bench.py eval, max_tokens 1024, temperature 0; the primary metric is its adjudicated pass /180

receipts_arm.definition: paradigms/receipts.py with_receipts() applied post hoc to every tool_sft record (Haven-rendered evidence and proposal receipts from successful tool outputs only)
receipts_arm.predictions: For every round-2 model, strict with-receipts (receipts.strict_receipt_passes) >= model-only.
receipts_arm.kill: Mean strict gain across round-2 models < 1 episode, or any model whose strict gains are fewer than half its raw receipt gains (receipts would then mostly be hiding bad answers). 'receipts_lost == 0' is not a test: it holds by construction.
receipts_arm.amended: 2026-10-27 before any round-2 inference, after independent review of the round-1 post-hoc analysis.

lfm25-8b-a1b.adjudicated: ranking vs qwen35-4b matches round 1 (4B ahead)
lfm25-8b-a1b.kill: LFM ahead of the 4B on the adjudicated suite (round-1 ranking does not generalize)

decision_rules: A model replaces the deployed default only if it beats qwen35-4b on BOTH suites with a paired sign test p < 0.05 on tool_sft and decode >= 20 tok/s at 1K.
Otherwise it may be offered in the Lab catalog as an explicit choice with its measured numbers, never as the default.
Results from one greedy seed are reported as such; no breakthrough is claimed from round 2 alone.

models.role: reference (deployed), re-run in the same session
larger dense member of the deployed family
models.note: Expected to fall back to -c 8192 on 8 GB; the 32K probe is then DOES_NOT_FIT.

models.license: LFM Open License v1.0 (license: other, lfm1.0)

models.role: stretch: RAM-resident mid-size MoE, experts offloaded (thesis M1)
models.paradigm: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention with fine-grained MoE (35B total, ~3B active)

budget: One GPU session, 150 minutes including the Strata restore. The 35B runs last; it is skipped if fewer than 45 minutes remain.
privacy: Records, transcripts and keys stay in the private output directory; only sanitized aggregates are published.
